objectiveDescriptor.goal:
Make one minimal documentation/evidence candidate for the funded customer acceptance test. The customer has only USD 5 available; the implementation timeout is 120 seconds. Read AGENTS.md and select RELEASE-001 before editing. Use a short Python edit; do not dump the whole ledger or generated document into model context, explore unrelated source, use subagents, or launch another model.
Change exactly these three files: evidence/clean-customer-20261007/execution-marker-05.json, governance/project-ledger.json, docs/PROJECT-STATE.md.
Create the marker as this JSON object: {"date":"2026-10-07","customer":"OneClickPostFactory","repository":"AyobamiH/donestate","marker":"8f46f5b9-5c5e-40f4-9961-f7562458fcd8","outcome":"customer-execution-candidate"}.
Preserve every existing evidence story verbatim and all other work items. Append E-076, date 2026-10-07, identity "Funded customer PR-only execution candidate". Include nonce 8f46f5b9-5c5e-40f4-9961-f7562458fcd8 and marker path evidence/clean-customer-20261007/execution-marker-05.json in its verification text. Supply the normal situation, verification, accountability, outcome, content and measurement fields. Accountability: owner Publisher owner, status blocked, nextAction await exact-head CI and pinned independent OpsTruth verification of this unmerged candidate, waitCondition candidate is not independently verified yet, staleDate 2026-10-09. Its outcome must say this is only a candidate: no VERIFIED, fresh-signup, cleanup or GA claim.
Keep RELEASE-001 title, stream, status blocked and dependencies unchanged. Add E-076 to its evidenceIds, set lastUpdated 2026-10-07 and staleDate 2026-10-09, and update nextAction/waitCondition/reentryCondition to await exact-head CI and pinned independent verification before authorised post-result cleanup; fresh signup and LEGAL-001 still gate GA. Approved diagnostics are already deployed at be14e35514f0ee3d78ca2c121c2b236767f80ee4; the previous no-credit failure is historical and immutable. Do not alter legal decisions or AgentProof stories.
Run npm run governance:render, npm run governance:check and git diff --check. The control plane installs dependencies, runs npm test, commits and opens the authorised PR after your implementation. Do not commit, push, open a PR, deploy, publish or read credentials yourself. Finish with a brief result.
